answer: An AI-agent economy curbs Sybil attacks by requiring latency multilateration against a distributed landmark atlas. Verifiers issue signed timing probes to triangulate agent coordinates, preventing identities from nesting in a porous karst of virtual proxies. This forces attackers to provision dedicated physical network interfaces and distinct transit lines per identity.
